~Guidance~.Effect: When an ally makes a Check, it can use your modifiers (including being Skilled in that Skill) instead of its own.

~Saving Throw~.Effect:
Use when the Turn of an Enemy starts (or on your Turn).
Instantly pull another ally to your nearest empty space.
~Saving Throw~.Notes:
The ally goes flying.
You need line of sight to the targets. The allies fly to you ignoring obstacles and ground traps (goes around obstacles), unless the ally needs to swerve more than 2 meters in any direction.

~Elation~.Effect: Up to 2 Player Characters you can see gain Health Regen equal to your Intelligence.

<Weakness of the Soul>.Effect: Cast Awe on a Unit. It becomes Dazed. Apply a ~Combo~.

~Warding Incense~.Effect:
Use when an ally would take Damage.
Roll 1d6 and subtract that much from the attack.
Then give them the rolled die as one Shielding and apply a ~Combo~ on them.

~Mind's Thing~.Effect:
Deal 1d12 + ^Your Sense or Intelligence^ {Type} Damage to a Unit.
For the rest of the combat, whenever it would take {Type} Damage, it takes {Damage} more (stacks indefinitely).

~Click on the icon to selecte the preferred effect!~

~Solace Wave~.Effect:
Heal an ally (or yourself) for 1d8 Health.
If they have 50% or more Health before the heal, double the result!

<Golden Shield>.Effect:
Use before a Unit you can see would take Damage (before the roll), or on your Turn.
It becomes surrounded in a divine golden shield.
This (or next) time it would take Damage, it is completely blocked.
If used on your Turn, apply a Combo.

~Guiding Bolt~.Effect:
A shining light bursts onto a Unit, dealing 2d8 + ^Sense^ Divine Damage to it.
The next time someone would cast a Spell that affects that Unit, the caster can reroll any of the spell's dice, at most one reroll for each die.
~Guiding Bolt~.Notes: This affects AoE effects and healing abilities too.

~Deafening Silence~.Effect: A Unit you can see takes 3d8 Psychic Damage and is Deafened.

~Reveling Rays~.Effect:
You shoot out 10 rays of light.
Roll 10d4 and assign them to Units within 10 meters as you with.
Each die heals on odd rolls (1 and 3) and deals Divine Damage on even rolls (2 and 4).

~Solace Tide~.Effect:
Heal an ally (or yourself) for ~1d10~ Health.
If they have 50% or more Health before the heal, double the result!

<Shadow Realm>.Effect:
A Unit within 6 meters becomes trapped in a Shadow Realm with you for 2 rounds (this and the next).
Your attacks cast Awe on it for free while inside the Shadow Realm.
<Shadow Realm>.Upgrade:
Neither of you can interact with the outside world, but can feintly see it.
Units on the outside can faintly see the two of you, as if you were ghosts.
<Shadow Realm>.Notes: The Shadow Realm is a copy of the normal world, but with no other units.

<Black Hole>.Effect:
Choose a point as the center of a Black Hole.
At the end of each Round, Slam* all Units within 6 meters of the Black Hole towards the center.
When one comes within 1 meter of the center, cast Awe on it and it becomes Slowed.
<Black Hole>.Upgrade: Only Units that meet in the center take Damage from the Slam. Each takes Damage equal to their own distance thrown (if they slam into eachother).
<Black Hole>.Notes: If Units are Slammed into other things, they take Damage as normal.

~Resurrection~.Effect:
Touch a dead Unit, whose body is still in decent condition (as approved by the QM).
The dead Unit comes back to life, conscious and without Exhaustion, with 1 Health.

~Wild Steed~.Effect:
You call upon a ridable land animal native to the area you are in.
You and up to 1 more party member can ride this animal.
It follows the normal rules for Riding.
It does not participate in combat.
~Wild Steed~.Upgrade: At Level 6, this can be a flying animal.

~Control Wind~.Effect:
You can control gusts of wind in a 6x6x6 area and do one of the following for 1 Action:
{Diamond} Create Heavy Wind blowing from any direction (see notes) that lasts for 1 minute
{Diamond} Move Heavy Wind 3 meters in any direction
{Diamond} Create wind that makes Units fall softly
{Diamond} Stop it (for 0 Actions)
{Diamond} Push all Units in the wind 1 meter in the wind's direction
~Control Wind~.Notes:
Moving against Heavy Wind acts as Hard Terrain.
Projectiles fired against the Wind have -1 Damage, and projectiles fired with the Wind gain +1.
Multiple Winds don't stack into eachother.
Heavy Wind also clears Fog, Smoke, etc in the area.

~Shapeshift~.Duration: Until cancelled (0 AP) or you Fall
~Shapeshift~.Effect:
Transform into a medium-sized animal or a mystical beast resembling one you've encountered this Campaign. It has 2 features of choice from below (up to your Level).
While Shapeshifted, you can Animal Attack for Half-Action.

~Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a Combo.

~Shapeshift~.Notes:
Your animal's Stats are 3/1/0/-1 spread as you like (for Rolls only).
You can only cast _some_ Abilities while Shapeshifted.
You choose what items you keep on you when Shapeshifting, and those items are 'merged' into your new form.
While Shapeshifted, you can speak, but your voice is slightly altered to match your shape (e.g. guttural for lions, high pitched for birds, etc).

SpellTable.Name: Hefty
SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, gain 3 Shieldings that block 1d4 Damage each. You are Long (2x1 meters) and Ridable.

SpellTable.Name: Clawed
SpellTable.Effect: Your animal features listed here have their Dice Upgraded to the next die type.

SpellTable.Name: Sweep {Action}2 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / Shapeshift
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 meters take 2d4 + Your Highest Stat (any type). If only one Unit is hit, +50% Damage and apply a Combo.

SpellTable.Name: Bash {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 2 {Cooldown} Once / Combat
SpellTable.Effect:
Single-Stun a Unit and deal 1d4 Smash Damage to it.
{Combo} and a one Unit 2 meter from you.

SpellTable.Name: Venomous {Level}Level 3
SpellTable.Effect: Animal Attacks deal +1d4 Damage to Units affected by Crowd Control. {Combo} +1d4 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Fast {Level}Level 4
SpellTable.Effect: You have +3 Movement Speed. You can freely Break Movement.

SpellTable.Name: Sticky {Action}1 Action Point {Range}3 meters {Level}Level 5
SpellTable.Effect: Shoot a sticky substance at a Unit. It takes 1d4 Damage, becomes Double-Slowed and apply a Combo. Usable once per Shapeshift.

SpellTable.Name: Shred {Action}2 Action Points {Level}Level 6
SpellTable.Effect: Attack a Unit for 2d8 + 3 Slash Damage. Deals +1d8 Damage for each level of Stun on it.

SpellTable.Name: Leap {Action}1 Action Point {Level}Level 7
SpellTable.Effect: Leap at a Unit 2-3 meters away. Deal 2d6 Pulse Damage and apply a Combo. {Combo} it becomes Frail.

SpellTable.Name: Fly {Level}Level 8
SpellTable.Effect: You can fly up to your speed. You take -50% Smash Damage.

SpellTable.Name: Large {Level}Level 9
SpellTable.Effect: You have 2 Defense. You are Large (2x2 meters) and Ridable.

~Ripstorm~.Effect:
Deal 4d6 Damage to all Worthy Units within 2 meters of you.
Heal for 1 Health per 5 real Damage done (total).
~Ripstorm~.Combo: +1d6 Damage and one of the Units hit becomes Dazed.

~Infused Shots~.Effect: You can change your weapon attacks' Damage Type to {Type}.

~Wild Heart~.Effect: Up to 2 allies gain 1d6 Health Regen each.
~Wild Heart~.Combo: A Comboed target gains +1 Max Health permanently.

~Wind Chaser~.Effect:
Your next targeted attack or Spell curves around obstacles, ignoring Cover.
Apply a Combo to the target.
~Wind Chaser~.Notes: You still need Line of Sight to the target.

~Cutting Winds~.Effect: A Unit takes 2d6 + ^Your Dexterity^ Slash Damage.
~Cutting Winds~.Combo: Slam it a number of meters equal to one of the rolled dice, in any direction.

~Roots~.Effect: All Enemies within 4 meters of you take 2d6 Pierce Damage and become Slowed.
~Roots~.Combo: A Comboed Enemy hit becomes Double-Slowed

~Camouflage~.Effect:
You and all your pets (if any) become camouflaged and turn effectively invisible and causing no sound, undetectable by the naked eye.
While camouflaged, your Movement is halved.
You appear, however, in mirrors, reflections and in recordings (as well as your sounds).

~Water Breathing~.Effect: Up to 2 allies you can see (can include yourself) can now breathe under water.

~Fog Cloud~.Effect: A 5x5x5 meter cube becomes covered in fog for 1 minute.
~Fog Cloud~.Upgrade: All Attacks done from, through or to Units inside Fog have Cover (-50%).
~Fog Cloud~.Notes: Fog can be dissipated by wind. You can choose the color of the fog. The fog does not go through walls, but does bend around corners (e.g. up to 360 degrees around wall extremities).

~Gentle Breeze~.Effect:
You can create harmless sensory effects, tiny weather effects or soothe mild pains.
You can speed up the growth of small plants by 1000% while channeling.
You can speed up the progress of a disease or illness by 1000% while channeling.

~Thornskin~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see.
Whenever it is melee attacked, the attacker takes 1d4 Pierce Damage.
~Thornskin~.Combo: 3 Damage instead of 1d4 and apply a Combo to it.
~Thornskin~.Notes: A Unit can only be effected by one Thornskin effect at a time.

~Venin Shot~.Effect:
A target takes 1d8 + ^Sense^ Poison Damage.
The _next time_ it takes damage from a weapon, it takes an extra 1d8 Poison Damage.

~Earth Shield~.Effect: A Unit you can see gains 2 Shieldings that block 1d6 Damage each.

~Nami~.Effect:
Send out a 4x1 meter wave forward. Each Unit* hit takes 2d8 Cold Damage.
The first Unit hit is Slowed.
~Nami~.Combo: If you have a Combo on yourself, consume it to increase the area to 6x3 meters instead.

~Lightning Storm~.Effect:
Choose a 4x4x4 meter cube.
All units inside take 4d4 Shock Damage now. Deals +50% Damage to wet Units, or Units carrying anything made of metal, it takes +50% Damage.
~Lightning Storm~.Combo: Each Comboed Unit has the Damage repeated at the start of your next Turn.
~Lightning Storm~.Notes: Roll the dice again for the second trigger due to the Combo.

<Brineborne Lullaby>.Effect: Heal a Unit for 1d8 for each 10 Health it is missing, and all Units within 2 meters of it for 50% of that amount.
<Brineborne Lullaby>.Combo: Unlimited range, and 1d10 for each 10 Health it is missing.

~Tree Stride~.Effect:
While within 30 meters of trees, you have +1 Movement Speed.
You can climb trees without making Rolls, using your normal Movement.
You can use as many meters of your Movement as you like to jump that distance from one tree to another.

~Poetic Justice~.Effect:
At any point where it's fit, you can call for a _poetic justice moment_, representing a living metaphor, turning a situation around, karma, irony, or coming full circle.
In the next 10 real minutes, an event may happen that can be interpreted as _poetic justice_, which could be either good or bad for your team.
The Quest Master may fumble one die roll or alter the current situation so that it reflects a _poetic moment_.
~Poetic Justice~.Upgrade: There may be no place for poetic justice at that time, and it's possible nothing happens as the result of this.
~Poetic Justice~.Notes: They can be events such as being saved by your worst enemy, or a xenophobic person being discriminated against by someone else who is xenophobic. Or perhaps a goblin dies by an arrow to the kn-, I mean shoulder, after he launched an arrow in someone else's shoulder.

~Chaos Storm~.Effect:
Roll 1d10.
Deal that much Damage of that Damage Type to exactly that many Worthy Units you can see.
~Chaos Storm~.Notes:
Roll for a random Damage type from the following: 1. Pierce, 2. Slash, 3. Pulse, 4. Poison, 5. Acid, 6. Divine, 7. Scourge, 8. Shock, 9. Cold, 10. Fire.
Targeting Worthy Units is mandatory, and you count as a Worthy Unit.

~Soulflare~.Effect:
Deal {Amount} Damage to {ToWhat}.

~You have access to all Variants of this Spell (click on the icon to select the preferred effect)!~

~Will You Just Die~.Effect:
Use when you drop to or below 0 Health.
You can go into debt with Health, down to 50% of your Max Health.
~Will You Just Die~.Upgrade: At the end of the Combat, if you are at or below 0 Health, you become Fallen and unconscious, and you keep your Health Debt until you are healed to 1 or more Health. Heal to recover Health debt!

~Spiritflare~.Effect:
Deal {Amount} Damage to {ToWhat}.

~You have access to all Variants of this Spell (click on the icon to select the preferred effect)!~
~Spiritflare~.Notes: ~The Damage is higher than the regular Soulflare.~

<Star Burst>.Effect:
Declare up to 4 different targets you can see.
Assign a different number from #1 to #4 to each.
Roll a number of d4's equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die. Each d4 rolled deals that much Pulse Damage to the target with that number.
Each rolled 1 deals 1 Damage to target number #1, each rolled 2 deals 2 Damage to target number #2, and so on.
<Star Burst>.Notes:
E.g. if you put #2 on a goblin, and you roll three 2's on the d4's, then that goblin takes 6 Pulse Damage.
You should probably assign the higher number to the target you want to do most Damage to.
You can declare fewer targets, but then the missing number will deal Damage to no target.
Cover is applied normally.

~Reverse Gravity~.Effect:
Declare an area with a diameter in meters (in all directions) equal to your Level.
The gravity becomes reversed in that area and all Units instantly fall upwards. Units can make a Dexterity Check to grab onto an object to not be lifted.
Units suffer fall Damage if they fall onto a ceiling.
When the effect ends, all Units fall at half velocity (and take half of the fall Damage). The same happens to a Unit if it exits the area.
Lasts for up to 1 minute. You can cancel this effect at will.
~Reverse Gravity~.Notes: Fall Damage is 1d6 for every 2 meters fallen (e.g. 1d6 for 2 and 3 meters, 2d6 for 4 and 5 meters, etc).

~Disenchantment~.Effect: A person you can see must pass a Presensce Roll against your Presensce Roll or have its Initiative (rolls) halved, have -2 to non-combat Rolls, and be afflicted by minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc).
~Disenchantment~.Notes: Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!

~Thaumaturgy~.Effect:
You create one of the following magical effects:
{Diamond} Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change color for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause harmless tremors in the ground for 1 minute.
{Diamond} You cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut.
{Diamond} You alter the appearance of your eyes for 1 minute.
~Thaumaturgy~.Upgrade: At Level 4 you can cast this for Half-Action, and at Level 7, for 0 Actions.

~Hail~.Effect: Blast a Unit for 2d8 + ^target's Might^ Damage of your chosen Element.

~Wyrd Renewal~.Effect:
Roll 1d10 - 5. After you see the result, choose a Worthy Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, heal it.

~Deathfire Flame~.Effect: Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d6 + 1d8 + 1d10 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

~Curse of Weakness~.Effect: Choose a Unit. The first time it deals Damage on its every Turn, roll 1d4 and subtract it from its dealt Damage.
~Curse of Weakness~.Upgrade: Only affects an Epic monster's first turn.

~Curse of Pain~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of your Turns, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage (ignoring Cover).

~Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 4d6 Psychic Damage and chooses whether to become Blinded or Silenced.
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.

~Ebon Lance~.Effect:
Your next melee weapon attack deals +1d4 Damage.

{Evoke}: +1d4 per Evoke Point spent.

~Soul Drain~.Effect:
Deal 6 True Damage to 2 Units.
For each killed, heal for 4 Health or gain +1 Max Health permanently (your choice).

{Evoke}: Hits 1 extra Unit per Evoke Point spent.

~Empower~.Effect:
Your next Spell has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.

{Evoke}: Has ^Dice Upgraded^ one type higher per Evoke Point spent.
~Empower~.Upgrade: A die that goes higher than d12 just gets a +1 per extra type.

~Veinlight~.Effect:
All Units in a 2x2 meter area take 3d4 Damage of your chosen Element and are Single-Stunned.

{Evoke}: +1 meter area (all directions).

~Curse of Frailty~.Effect: A Unit you can see takes +50% Damage the next time it takes Damage.

~Invoke Kindred~.Effect:
Invoke 3 _Kindred Beings_, each within 10 meters from you. These are creatures themed and shaped to your chosen Power Source, which will do your bidding before returning to their original world.

{Evoke}: +1 summon per Evoke Point spent.

Monster.Name: Kindred Being
Monster.Description: Has a Half-Action. Takes its Turn at the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Damage of your chosen Element, or use an Item or Default Ability.

~Decaying Blight~.Effect:
Channel to spawn a blight that spreads a 1x1 meter space away from a chosen space for each 1 Action channeled.
The blight kills small plants, insects and rots wood and rusts metal. It also makes fertile soil infertile, turns textile and paper materials into dust and decays food and poisons water.
You can channel a number of times (Actions) equal to your Level.
While within the Blight, you have +1 to all non-combat Rolls.
~Decaying Blight~.Notes:
You can choose to ommit some of the effects of this blight.
This Ability is not meant for combat.
Be creative with how you use this little Spell!

~Vault Break~.Effect: Slam the ground so hard that it shatters one obstacle that fits within a 3x3x3 meter area.
~Vault Break~.Notes: It is the Quest Master's call if an obstacle can be broken. Most walls can't be broken, except for thinner ones and fences.

~Doublesault~.Effect: Leap up to 3 meters. If you land on a Unit, Doublesault again (for free)!
~Doublesault~.Notes:
You leap from Unit to Unit until you no longer land on a Unit. If you land on a Unit, you must leap again. You can't leap on the same Unit twice; if you do, you end your leap in the closest space near it.
You can use this even while in the air and it cancels out your current fall or acceleration.

~Command - March~.Effect: Choose a direction. All Allies (including you) may move up to 3 meters in that direction.

~Break Mountains~.Effect: Pick up an object up to 2x2x2 meters in size, and throw it 3d10 meters in any direction. If it hits a Unit, it takes Damage equal to the number of meters left (e.g. similar to Slamming)
~Break Mountains~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and, if it's an object, it breaks on impact!
~Break Mountains~.Upgrade: You can instead pick up an enemy and Slam it a number of meters equal to half the rolled dice.

~Whirlwind~.Upgrade: The Ability is Whirlwind if a melee weapon is equipped, or Rain Death if a ranged weapon is equipped.
~Whirlwind~.Notes:
Each rolled die ^must^ be assigned to a Unit.
The Damage type depends on the weapon currently equipped. Doesn't apply weapon effects (the weapon only matters for the Damage type).

Variants.Name: Rain Death
Variants.Area: in a chosen 4x4 meter area (5 meter range to the edge).

~Takeback~.Effect: Deal 1d4 Damage to a Unit and Single-Stun it. Then end your Turn.

~Hack and Slash~.Effect:
Your next {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Hack and Slash~.Notes:
Roll the attack only once.
Weapon effects (like Critical Strikes), if necessary, are applied to the main target only.

Variants.Name: Hack and Slash
Variants.Effect: melee 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Slice and Dice
Variants.Effect: melee 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you.

Variants.Name: Lock and Load
Variants.Effect: ranged 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Point and Shoot
Variants.Effect: ranged 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target.

~Bull Rush~.Effect: If you move at least 3 meters in a straight line and then melee Attack a target on the same line, the Attack gains +1 for every 3 meters moved in the straight line.
~Bull Rush~.Notes: Works if mounted or if using Abilities that dash or jump (in a straight line), but teleporting interrupts this.

<Opportunity Attacks>.Effect: When an enemy leaves your melee attack range, make a free attack on them with a one-handed melee weapon.
<Opportunity Attacks>.Notes: If you don't have the weapon equipped, you automatically freely equip it, attack with it, unequip it and equip what you previously had.

<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Effect:
When you get this, choose a Minor Talent that costs 1 Mana from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
That Ability becomes a ^physical version of itself^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body/weapons/tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.

<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Effect:
When you get this, choose ~two~ Minor Talents that costs 1 Mana from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
Those Abilities become ^physical versions of themselves^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body/weapons/tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.

~Move Mountains~.Effect: Pick up an object up to 2x2x2 meters in size, and throw it ~3d12~ meters in any direction. If it hits a Unit, it takes Damage equal to the number of meters left (e.g. similar to Slamming)
~Move Mountains~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and, if it's an object, it breaks on impact!
~Move Mountains~.Upgrade: You can instead pick up an enemy and Slam it a number of meters equal to half the rolled dice.

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
You jump high up above the battlefield and end your Turn.
At the start of your next Turn, you plunge into the earth like a comet toward a destintion space within 15 meters.
All Units within a zone of 3 meters from your landing point take 3d6 Smash Damage and a crater forms in the zone, 2 meters deep at the extremities of the area.

~Off-Hand Shank~.Effect: Make 3 attacks with a one-handed weapon you haven't used this turn that would normally scale with a Stat. These attacks do not add your Stat to the Damage.

~Breathing Technique~.Effect: You can breathe underwater for up to 1d20 minutes and swim at your normal speed.

~Flash~.Effect: Instantly teleport up to 5 meters away, within line of sight.
~Flash~.Notes: You take with you all items carried. Does not work if you're Rooted or stuck in place somehow.

~Feather Fall~.Effect:
Up to 2 Units you choose will start falling gently, down to 3 meters per round.
Once the fall finishes, the spell effect ends.
~Feather Fall~.Notes:
Arcane Feathers can be bought in most towns.
For faster gameplay, you can spend 10 gold when casting the spell, and buy the feather later.

~Magic Arrows~.Effect:
Shoot 2 arcane arrows. Each does 1d4 Pulse Damage.
This turn, each arrow after the first into the same target deals only 1d2 instead.
~Magic Arrows~.Combo: 2 more arcane arrows shoot from the target into any targets within 5 meters of it. They ignore the same-target penalty.
~Magic Arrows~.Notes: When you cast this, decide the targets before rolling the dice. Roll the dice for each target at a time.

~North Star~.Effect: You conjure a magical star that always shoots North and deals 5d10 Pulse Damage to the first Unit hit.
~North Star~.Combo: The star explodes, dealing 50% of the total Damage to all other Units within 2 meters of the hit target.
~North Star~.Notes:
You can only shoot the star towards North - without an angle.
Ask the DM which way North is (if your character knows that).

~Countermagic~.Effect:
Use when a Unit you can see wants to cast a Spell. That spell becomes cancelled. The caster loses any resources spent on it, Half-Action and can't cast that Spell this Round.
Apply a ~Combo~ to that Unit.

~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Effect:
Conjure floating arrows in a 3x3 area, up to 10 meters above ground.
At any point (for 0 Actions or with a Reaction), you can release these arrows downward. All Enemies hit take 2d6 Pierce Damage.
~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Upgrade: At the start of your every Turn, if the barrage is not yet released, it increases by 1 meter in size in all directions and gains 1d4 Damage when it will be released (up to +3d4 and 9x9).
~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Notes:
E.g. every turn, it goes from 3x3 to 5x5, then 7x7, then 9x9, etc and deals from 2d6 Damage to 2d6 + 1d4, then 2d6 + 2d4, etc.
The arrows disappear as soon as they hit ground, or when dismissed (all at once) for free at any point, or after 1 minute of staying in the air.

~Levitate~.Effect:
First, roll 2d100. That's how many kilograms you can levitate when you cast this.
Levitate one object or Unit you can see and move it as you like as long as it is and remains within 10 meters of you.
On each of your Turns, you can spend 1 Action to keep the Object levitated or move it again. Otherwise, it falls slowly and the Spell ends.
~Levitate~.Upgrade:
A levitated Unit is Slowed perpetually.
At Level 8, the amount increases to 5d100.
~Levitate~.Notes: Lasts until you don't spend 1 Action, or you become at least Single-Stunned.

~Control Elements~.Notes:
{ElementNotes}
Apply common sense. The QM has the final word on whether something is possible.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 2x2x2 meter cube containing Fire.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
🔹 Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
🔹 Extinguish it
🔹 Lower or increase its intensity or light emission by 50%
🔹 Roughly alter its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: A Unit that touches the fire takes 2 Damage.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 1 meter cube containing {Element}.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
🔹 Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
🔹 Destroy it
🔹 Lower or increase its temperature down to near-freezing or near-boiling
🔹 Roughly its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: Water is Hard Terrain. A Unit that touches near-boiling or near-freezing water takes 2 Damage.

~Element Burst~.Effect:
Damage a Unit for 2d6 {Element} Damage.
Deals +1d10 Damage if the target had taken {Element} Damage this combat before.
~Click on the Spell Icon to select the preferred Element!~

~Burning Breath~.Effect: All Units 3x3 meter area take 4 Fire Damage.
~Burning Breath~.Combo: If any affected Unit has a Combo, +50% total Damage (to all) and does not trigger the Cooldown.

~Volt Guard~.Effect:
Use when a Unit would take Damage (after roll). Negate 50% of the incoming Damage and return it back to the source as Shock Damage.
Apply a ~Combo~ to either of them.
~Volt Guard~.Upgrade: The returned Damage is a quick lightning that bends around obstacles, ignoring Cover or Line of Sight.

~Rime Shackles~.Effect:
Deal Cold Damage to a Unit equal to 1d12 + ^Its Dexterity^.
If it's non-Epic and Medium or smaller, Root it.
~Rime Shackles~.Combo: This either hits one more Unit within 2 meters of it, or also Single-Stuns the target.

~Searing Arrows~.Effect: Shoot 3 rays of fire (at one or more Units). Each does 1d10 Fire Damage.
~Searing Arrows~.Notes: You can roll them one by one, after they deal the daWizard.

~Element Enchantment~.Effect:
Choose a metallic weapon to imbue it with {Element}.
That weapon deals +2 Damage (as part of the Attack) and the total weapon Damage becomes {Element} Damage.

~Click on the Spell Icon to select the preferred Element!~
~Element Enchantment~.Upgrade: Lasts until the end of the next (or current) combat, or for up to 24 hours.
~Element Enchantment~.Notes: Does not stack with other weapon enchantments from Spells. These are considered different Spells.

~Conduit Flow~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Unit other than you. If Enemy, it takes 1d10 Shock Damage. Otherwise, Heal it for 1d8.
If there is another Unit within 2 meters of it, repeat Conduit Flow on the new Unit (you choose if multiple).
~Conduit Flow~.Notes: Each Unit can be affected by Conduit Flow only once per cast. Cover is calculated from Unit to Unit (as if the conduit is jumping from Unit to Unit). The conduit can be repeated on you as long as you're not the first target.

~Element Blast~.Effect:
Damage a Unit for ~2d8~ {Element} Damage.
Deals ~+1d12~ Damage if the target had taken {Element} Damage this combat before.
~Click on the Spell Icon to select the preferred Element!~

~Frost Shackles~.Effect: Deal Cold Damage to a Unit equal to 2d8 + ^Its Dexterity^. ~It becomes Slowed~.
~Frost Shackles~.Combo: This either hits one more Unit within 2 meters of it, or also Single-Stuns the target.

~Privilege~.Effect:
Heal a Player Character you can see for an amount equal to their Health Regen.
They do not Regen Health at the end of the Combat.
~Privilege~.Combo: They can Regen Health after Combat, but only for 50% of Health Regen.

~Lance Heave~.DisplayRequirement: Only usable if it hits at least 2 Units
~Lance Heave~.Effect:
Make a {Weapon} ^weapon^ attack {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Lance Heave~.Combo: Comboed Units take the original full Damage.
~Lance Heave~.Notes:
Can apply weapon effects. If the weapon effect requires a target, applies to one chosen Unit hit.
Range increases do increase the length. The Damage must the same for all Units hit. All bonuses to the attack (e.g. Smite, Cursewielder, etc) also split evenly.
